kv17.4:1.3: Indriyabaddhañ ñeva aniccaṃ saṃkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhamman ti?
kv17.4:1.5: Nanu anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṃkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhāmmaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhamman ti?
kv17.4:1.7: Hañci anindriyabaddhaṃ --pe-- vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.4:2.2: vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, tañ ca na dukkhan ti?
kv17.4:2.5: vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, tañ ca na dukkhan ti?
kv17.4:4.3: Nanu yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā,
kv17.4:4.6: Hañci yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā,
kv17.4:4.7: anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.4:5.4: Yathā indriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti?
kv17.4:5.6: Yathā indriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjatīti?
kv17.4:5.8: Tena hi indriyabaddhañ ñeva dukkhan ti.
